explanation: The lemma is a definitional (`rfl`) computation specific to this library's own `ShortComplex.RightHomologyData.unop` construction (defined in Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/RightHomology.lean) and to the library's own defs `LeftHomologyData.f'` / `RightHomologyData.g'` (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/LeftHomology.lean, RightHomology.lean). It relates `f'` of the `LeftHomologyData` obtained by `unop` to the `unop` of the given `g'`. I grepped the whole Homology directory for `unop_f'`, `unop_g'`, `op_f'`, `op_g'` and for lemmas of the shape `(unop|op)_(f'|g'|i|p|ι|π|K|Q|H)`; the only matches are the sibling lemmas `RightHomologyData.op_f'`, `RightHomologyData.unop_f'`, `LeftHomologyData.op_g'`, `LeftHomologyData.unop_g'`, all in the same file (no `@[simps]`-generated version exists since `f'`/`g'` are not structure projections). The content lies entirely in this library's definitions, so no distinct Mathlib declaration duplicates it.
